player.name: Unnamed
player.description: Athletic, strong hobgoblin variant. Taller than a human man, long powerful limbs, defined muscular build, no tusks. Retains all wolf-touched senses and bear-touched density, tougher skin, and claw-like nails. Formerly ordinary goblin.

stats.notes: Hobgoblin-scale athletic frame. Crushing strength, high speed and endurance, enhanced senses, tougher hide, accelerated healing.

physiology.baseForm: Athletic hobgoblin variant, no tusks, sharper facial features
wolfTraits: Coarser hair on forearms and shoulders
bearTraits: Dense packed muscle and greater mass relative to frame
hobgoblinTraits: Hobgoblin height and reach (taller than human male)
Significantly increased base strength and speed
physiology.combinedNotes: All prior traits fully integrated into the new hobgoblin-scale body. No tusks. Face still recognizably derived from original. Elena has not yet seen the change.

inventory: Leather satchel with flint, rope, waterskin, whetstone
Wolf and bear pelt blankets (at house)

elena.notes: Unaware of the hobgoblin transformation yet.

history: Cleared hobgoblin den through night stealth and open combat.
Ate hobgoblin heart. Transformed into athletic hobgoblin variant retaining wolf and bear traits.
